description: Header file for Lua-based condition handling in Lighttpd, defining functions to initialize, retrieve, push, and set global conditions using Lua scripting.

methods.name: li_lua_init_condition_mt
methods.description: Initializes the Lua metatable for condition objects.

methods.name: li_lua_get_condition
methods.description: Retrieves a condition object from Lua stack.

methods.name: li_lua_push_condition
methods.description: Pushes a condition object onto the Lua stack.

methods.name: li_lua_set_global_condition_lvalues
methods.description: Sets global condition values in Lua from server context.
